events.comment: Seeds: RunSeed (global) is chosen once per run, 0 = not chosen yet. Seed (scene) is derived from it and the global Level, so every level differs but the whole run can be replayed with the same RunSeed. Type a number into RunSeed to replay a run.
Stationary guards (Mushnub) stand on the route from the start to the exit, with a blue mist under each
Level 1 has no enemies. From level 2 spawners create them; at most 2 + Level/2 (max 12) alive at once, and waves grow slowly with the level

Enemies that have not noticed the player patrol (UpdatePatrol). Once they see it (clear line in range) they chase: ground enemies follow the corridors, flying ones go straight. They may attack only with a clear line
Attack: close = melee hit, far = projectile (ranged role only)
Enemy projectiles: slow, so the player can dodge them. They vanish on walls and on the player
